title: Lag outside taps and pipes
why: Exposed pipes crack in a hard frost, and a burst pipe is expensive to fix.

title: Clear gutters and drains after leaf fall
why: Blocked gutters send rainwater down your walls instead of away from them.

title: Clear gutters and drains before the wettest month
why: A second check before your wettest month of the year keeps drains clear when it matters most.

title: Book your annual boiler service
why: An unserviced boiler is more likely to break down in winter, and less safe.

title: Book your annual heat pump service
why: A yearly check keeps a heat pump running efficiently through winter.

title: Check your oil tank and order a top-up
why: Oil prices and lead times both rise in winter - an autumn check avoids running dry.

title: Test your flood kit and door seals
why: Equipment that hasn't been checked since last winter may not work when you need it.

title: Check the roof and ridge tiles after the windiest month
why: Gale-force gusts loosen tiles and fixings; a quick look catches problems early.

title: Bleed your radiators
why: Trapped air makes radiators cold at the top and wastes heating.

title: Clean your solar panels
why: A clean panel generates noticeably more power through spring and summer.

title: Check trees near the house
why: A tree surgeon can spot storm-risk branches before the next gale does.
